# The winner of all_solutions_models_multihop: 'hybrid_rerank_default[generator=anthropic:claude-haiku-5-5]'. Run it with `ragbench run --config <this file>`.

  output_dir: results

  documents_path: data/multihop-rag-100/docs
  questions_path: data/multihop-rag-100/questions.jsonl

  name: hybrid_rerank_default[generator=anthropic:claude-haiku-5-5]

    chunk_size: 500
    chunk_overlap: 80

    - gpt-6-luna

    scorers: first
  trials: 1
  max_questions: null
  max_workers: 4
  max_cost_usd: 9.4
